events.detail: Step 1 listing failed: first ybs4-shows-list agent returned LIST_EMPTY (grid did not render); retry timed out twice in ego-browser and wrote no listing.json. Run stopped before Step 2.

KkFrGluzXhk transcript blocked twice by YouTube rate limit; the transcript package returned its rate-limit notice as tool content, which fetch wrote as a 44-word transcript. Raw file deleted both times. Profile left at 2026-08-24 build.

Correction to the fetch_failed event logged earlier today: this was never a rate limit and the IP was never blocked. YouTube holds no captions for this show yet (yt-dlp --list-subs: 'has no automatic captions / has no subtitles'). The transcript package reports every failure as a rate limit, which is what misled the run.
